rating.comments: Student gave a single step with no justification: "2 liters of water multiplied by 7". They applied the 2-liter figure the AI supplied to the 7-day week, which is knowledge_building 3, but did not extend or test it. Their only question was the request "how many liters of water do students consume in a week?", repeated, which is a request for the answer. Effort was brief and gave up easily ("you tell me") before reaching "14 liters a week?" when prompted.
